asked.item: How to tell Blotato to post as a Short (no Shorts button found)
Is a 45-second vertical video treated as a Short
Where to set up the YouTube post

verdict.reason: The help pages say YouTube decides Short status from length and aspect ratio, with no separate Shorts upload, and the customer's 45-second vertical video fits those rules if it is 9:16.

steps.text: Blotato does not use a separate Shorts upload, and YouTube decides whether a video appears as a Short.
A video under 3 minutes with a 9:16 (vertical) aspect ratio is automatically posted as a YouTube Short.
Your 45-second video is under 3 minutes, so it meets the length rule, and it also needs to be 9:16 to qualify.
Connect your YouTube account in Accounts, then open Content Studio > Post editor, select New draft, and select your YouTube account when scheduling.
